Manager Profile Summary

Dynamic operations and customer service professional with 7+ years of leadership experience at Samsung and Reliance Jio Infocomm Ltd. Skilled in business operations, strategic execution, team leadership, and customer service management. Currently serving as Assistant ASI at Reliance Jio since December 2023, leading operations across six Jio Centres and 36 Jio Points, managing a large field workforce, driving AirFiber projects, conducting Jio Centre and Jio Points audits, handling customer escalations, managing cease order collections, and ensuring inventory availability. Previously, at Samsung (June 2018 – October 2023), progressed from Executive to Manager, overseeing service center operations, maintaining service quality, and ensuring timely customer support. Strong in strategic planning, team coordination, and continuous process improvement, focused on achieving operational goals and delivering excellent customer experiences.

Portfolio Page 1 — Classroom Training Sessions & Hardware Demonstrations

Under Key Responsibility 2 & 3 at Reliance Jio Infocomm Ltd., Syed Turab Ali delivers structured classroom training and live hardware demonstrations for AirFiber Partners, Secondary Agents (S.A.), and field installation engineers across all 6 Jio Centres and 36 Jio Points.

Classroom Session I

Mimosa C6x Unboxing & Power-On Protocol

Instructing partner engineers and Secondary Agents on step-by-step installation procedures, alignment toolkit setup, mobile data isolation, and local Wi-Fi provisioning via the OPLPoE SSID.

Live Hardware Demonstration

ODU Antenna Demo & RPOS / DKYC Workflows

Conducting a hands-on physical demonstration of the AirFiber Outdoor Unit (ODU) and Mimosa C6x assembly in the classroom lab, paired with whiteboard training on RPOS Fiber, RPOS Mobile, and Jio DKYC.

Classroom Session II

Engineer Briefing & Firmware Diagnostics

Guiding field engineers through interactive screen walkthroughs covering Surge Protection Device (SPD) wiring, mounting brackets, and pre-deployment IDU/ODU/ONT/STB software verification.

Portfolio Page 2 — On-the-Job (OJT) Field Training & Customer Premises Audits

Complementing classroom instruction, Syed Turab Ali leads hands-on On-the-Job Training (OJT) directly in the field—training engineers on rooftop RF alignment, safety compliance, and customer-premises ONT/STB software upgradation.

Field OJT — Rooftop RF Deployment

External ODU & Mimosa C6x Alignment Training in Field

Delivering live rooftop field training (wearing safety helmet PPE) to field engineers and Secondary Agents, demonstrating pole-mount stability, azimuth/elevation alignment of the external Outdoor Unit (ODU), and RF signal optimization.

Field OJT — Customer Premises Audit

IDU, ONT & Set-Top Box (STB) Upgradation & Sign-Off

Conducting on-site quality inspection and live service verification with the field engineer and customer following successful Indoor Unit (IDU), Optical Network Terminal (ONT), and Set-Top Box (STB) software upgradation.
